tools.name: list_services
tools.description: The three service lines (build, grow, care) and every capability under them, with what each includes, the typical timeline, who works on it and how it is priced.

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: How Polargate engages: every model (Discovery Sprint, fixed-price projects, Care, Grow, the AI visibility audit) with what it includes, who it is for and how it is billed. Polargate does not publish prices: each engagement gets a fixed price, sent privately in writing after a first call.

tools.name: list_cases
tools.description: Projects Polargate has delivered, with the client where the client agreed to be named, measured outcomes, the stack and a link to the live site. Filter by industry or service line.

tools.name: get_case
tools.description: The full case study for one project, including the markdown of the page. Use list_cases first to find the slug.

tools.name: search_site
tools.description: Find pages by words in their title or description, across all three languages. Returns the page URL and its markdown twin.

tools.name: get_page
tools.description: The full text of any page on polargate.ai, as markdown. Give the route, for example /pricing or /es/work/hotel-marien.

tools.name: list_products
tools.description: Products Polargate makes and owns, as opposed to work for clients. PolarRabbit is a free Mac app.

tools.name: how_to_start
tools.description: How to engage Polargate: what the brief asks, the answer time, the languages spoken and where the work is done from.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_site · Public sink: get_pricing.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_site · Public sink: get_pricing

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
